claims.claim_text: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration to advance Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion.
claims.excerpt: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom today announced a collaboration to advance Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure — using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™

claims.claim_text: Rebellions will use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units to the NVIDIA platform and use the NVIDIA MGX rack architecture for rack-scale system development.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions will use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units (NPUs) to the NVIDIA platform, and harness the NVIDIA MGX™ rack architecture for rack-scale system development.

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems in its AI data center as part of a full-stack sovereign AI strategy.
claims.excerpt: SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems in its AI data center to support its vision for full-stack sovereign AI spanning infrastructure, proprietary models and public-facing services

claims.claim_text: Rebellions' R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions’ R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.

claims.claim_text: The companies plan a disaggregated inference approach using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode, which they say will improve throughput and power efficiency.
claims.excerpt: Their planned work includes using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve inference throughput and power efficiency.

claims.claim_text: Rebellions says the R200 NPU, still in development, is optimized for low-latency, energy-efficient inference on frontier models including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions is developing its next-generation R200 NPU, optimized for low-latency and energy-efficient inference using frontier models, including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.

claims.claim_text: Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT is supporting collaboration between NVIDIA and Korean NPU companies, beginning with Rebellions and SK Telecom.
claims.excerpt: MSIT is supporting collaboration between NVIDIA and Korean NPU companies, beginning with Rebellions and SK Telecom, to strengthen Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure.

claims.claim_text: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said NVLink Fusion lets Korea's chipmakers connect their custom ASICs to NVIDIA's AI factory platform.
claims.excerpt: With NVLink Fusion, Korea’s chipmakers can connect their custom ASICs to NVIDIA’s AI factory platform, tightly coupling their processors with NVIDIA compute to run AI workloads.

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom says it will link its AI data centers with proprietary models including A.X K2 and services from the 'AI for All' project.
claims.excerpt: By linking SKT’s AI data centers, proprietary AI models including A.X K2, and public-facing AI services developed under the ‘AI for All’ project

claims.claim_text: Rebellions is backed by investors including Aramco, Arm, Samsung, SK Hynix and SK Telecom.
claims.excerpt: the company is backed by Aramco, Arm, Kindred Ventures, KT, Mirae Asset Group, Samsung, SK Hynix and SK Telecom.
